001package com.streamconverter.command.impl.xml;
002
003import com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand;
004import com.streamconverter.command.rule.IRule;
005import com.streamconverter.path.TreePath;
006import com.streamconverter.security.SecureXmlConfiguration;
007import java.io.IOException;
008import java.io.InputStream;
009import java.io.OutputStream;
010import java.util.ArrayList;
011import java.util.List;
012import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventFactory;
013import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventReader;
014import javax.xml.stream.XMLEventWriter;
015import javax.xml.stream.XMLInputFactory;
016import javax.xml.stream.XMLStreamException;
017import javax.xml.stream.events.XMLEvent;
018import org.slf4j.Logger;
019import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
020
021/**
022 * XML Walker for applying transformations to XML data.
023 *
024 * <p>This command navigates through XML structures and applies transformations using rules while
025 * preserving the overall XML structure. It identifies specific elements using TreePath
026 * slash-delimited path expressions (e.g., {@code product/name}) and applies {@link IRule}
027 * transformations to the text content of matching nodes.
028 *
029 * <p>The full XML event stream — including the XML declaration, all elements, attributes, and text
030 * nodes — is written to the output. Only character data at nodes whose path exactly matches the
031 * configured {@link TreePath} is transformed by the rule; all other events are passed through with
032 * their XML information set (infoset) preserved.
033 *
034 * <p>Note on text handling: the underlying StAX reader is configured with {@code
035 * XMLInputFactory.IS_COALESCING}, so adjacent text fragments and CDATA sections are coalesced into
036 * a single character event before rules are applied. This guarantees that a rule sees the whole
037 * text content of a node even when the parser would otherwise split it (e.g. at CDATA boundaries).
038 * As a consequence, CDATA sections are written to the output as escaped character data — an
039 * infoset-equivalent representation — rather than being preserved verbatim.
040 */
041public class XmlWalker implements IStreamCommand {
042  private static final Logger logger = LoggerFactory.getLogger(XmlWalker.class);
043
044  private final TreePath treePath;
045  private final IRule rule;
046
047  /**
048   * Constructor for XML navigation with TreePath selector and transformation rule.
049   *
050   * @param treePath the TreePath to select elements
051   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
052   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
053   */
054  XmlWalker(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
055    if (treePath == null) {
056      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null");
057    }
058    if (rule == null) {
059      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
060    }
061    this.treePath = treePath;
062    this.rule = rule;
063  }
064
065  /**
066   * Factory method for creating an XML navigation command with TreePath and rule.
067   *
068   * @param treePath the TreePath to select elements
069   * @param rule the transformation rule to apply to selected elements
070   * @return an XmlWalker that transforms the specified TreePath elements with the given rule
071   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if treePath or rule is null
072   */
073  public static XmlWalker create(TreePath treePath, IRule rule) {
074    if (treePath == null) {
075      throw new IllegalArgumentException("TreePath cannot be null");
076    }
077    if (rule == null) {
078      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Rule cannot be null");
079    }
080    return new XmlWalker(treePath, rule);
081  }
082
083  @Override
084  public void execute(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream) throws IOException {
085    XMLEventReader eventReader = null;
086    XMLEventWriter eventWriter = null;
087    IOException primaryException = null;
088
089    try {
090      eventReader = createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
091      eventWriter = createXMLEventWriter(outputStream);
092      navigateXmlWithRule(eventReader, eventWriter, treePath, rule);
093      eventWriter.flush();
094    } catch (XMLStreamException e) {
095      primaryException = buildXmlException(e);
096    } finally {
097      primaryException = XmlStreamResources.closeAll(eventReader, eventWriter, primaryException);
098    }
099
100    if (primaryException != null) {
101      throw primaryException;
102    }
103  }
104
105  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidCatchingGenericException")
106  // IRule.apply() declares no checked exceptions; any RuntimeException must be caught and
107  // re-thrown as XMLStreamException so the caller's error-handling path is not bypassed.
108  private void navigateXmlWithRule(
109      XMLEventReader eventReader, XMLEventWriter eventWriter, TreePath treePath, IRule rule)
110      throws XMLStreamException {
111    XMLEventFactory eventFactory = XMLEventFactory.newInstance();
112    List<String> currentPath = new ArrayList<>();
113
114    while (eventReader.hasNext()) {
115      XMLEvent event = eventReader.nextEvent();
116
117      if (event.isStartElement()) {
118        currentPath.add(event.asStartElement().getName().getLocalPart());
119      } else if (event.isEndElement()) {
120        if (currentPath.isEmpty()) {
121          logger.warn(
122              "Unexpected end element '{}' with empty path stack — possible malformed XML",
123              event.asEndElement().getName().getLocalPart());
124        } else {
125          currentPath.remove(currentPath.size() - 1);
126        }
127      } else if (event.isCharacters() && treePath.matches(currentPath)) {
128        String data = event.asCharacters().getData();
129        String transformed;
130        try {
131          transformed = rule.apply(data);
132        } catch (RuntimeException ruleEx) {
133          throw new XMLStreamException("Rule application failed at path " + currentPath, ruleEx);
134        }
135        // Write every event unconditionally; character events at the target path are replaced
136        // above.
137        event = eventFactory.createCharacters(transformed);
138      }
139
140      eventWriter.add(event);
141    }
142  }
143
144  private XMLEventReader createXMLEventReader(InputStream inputStream) throws XMLStreamException {
145    XMLInputFactory inputFactory = SecureXmlConfiguration.createSecureXMLInputFactory();
146    // テキスト断片化防止のため coalescing を有効化する。CDATA 境界やパーサ内部バッファで
147    // 分割された連続テキストを 1 つの Characters イベントに結合し、ルールがテキスト
148    // コンテンツ全体に適用されることを保証する (#762)。XmlWalker ローカルの設定であり、
149    // SecureXmlConfiguration を共有する他コマンドには影響しない。
150    inputFactory.setProperty(XMLInputFactory.IS_COALESCING, true);
151    XMLEventReader reader = inputFactory.createXMLEventReader(inputStream);
152    if (!reader.hasNext()) {
153      try {
154        reader.close();
155      } catch (XMLStreamException closeEx) {
156        logger.warn("Failed to close empty XMLEventReader", closeEx);
157      }
158      throw new XMLStreamException("Empty XML input");
159    }
160    return reader;
161  }
162
163  /**
164   * 出力ストリームへの XMLEventWriter を作成する。
165   *
166   * <p>テスト時にオーバーライドしてファクトリをモック可能にするため protected スコープとしている。
167   *
168   * @param outputStream 書き込み先ストリーム
169   * @return 設定済み XMLEventWriter
170   * @throws XMLStreamException ライターの生成に失敗した場合
171   */
172  protected XMLEventWriter createXMLEventWriter(OutputStream outputStream)
173      throws XMLStreamException {
174    return SecureXmlConfiguration.createSecureXMLOutputFactory().createXMLEventWriter(outputStream);
175  }
176
177  private IOException buildXmlException(XMLStreamException e) {
178    String location = "";
179    if (e.getLocation() != null) {
180      int line = e.getLocation().getLineNumber();
181      int column = e.getLocation().getColumnNumber();
182      if (line > 0 && column > 0) {
183        location = String.format(" at line %d, column %d", line, column);
184      }
185    }
186    logger.error("XML processing failed{}", location, e);
187    return new IOException("XML processing failed" + location, e);
188  }
189}
